review_status: Completed targeted review: 17 identical stage cases per model, four models, 68 reviewed records. Fifteen other stage cases per model remain unreviewed.
scope: 13 previously ambiguous/insufficient stages, plus dance S6 and all five sport bar stages. Visual verdict concerns actual summary/criterion claims and never changes the strict stage-ID score.

rubric.correct: All substantive reviewed visible-content assertions are supported by supplied frames; appropriate unknowns are allowed. This is not clinical or process certification.
rubric.wrong: At least one concrete content/evidence claim contradicts actual frames, or a subsequent motion/completion claim cites earlier evidence. Exact ID alone does not set this verdict.
rubric.uncertain: No clear contradiction is established, but at least one affirmative contact, normality or posture claim cannot be verified from cropped, blurred or sparse evidence. Do not count this as confirmed correct.
rubric.frame_indexing: Use zero-based indices into the exact frozen manifest, with actual presentation timestamps. Correct object descriptions with wrong cited frames are flagged separately.
rubric.temporal_evidence: Raised then subsequently lowered requires chronologically ordered frames within the same view. An earlier low frame or a camera cut does not prove a later return.
rubric.crop: A cropped or occluded shoe/hand is unknown. Never assert both grounded or both in contact solely from one visible object.
rubric.phase_overlap: Report visual facts and strict ID separately. Plausible alternate phases do not become extra accepted IDs.
rubric.surgery: Retrospective description only. Visible tools/thread are not proof of normal functioning, diagnosis, a safe procedure or clinical success.

protocol_notes: Requested maximum nine frames over eight seconds; actual manifest counts/spans vary. Inspected dance/sport cases have eight frames over approximately 6.54s; dance S1 has nine over 6.97s. Inspected manufacturing/surgery cases have nine over 7.96s.
Identical frozen-manifest inputs remain comparable across models. Do not rewrite frames after models receive them.
No Q&A answers were available in the Guardian-only gpt-4o run; only Guardian summaries and criteria were reviewed.
Reviews are manual targeted judgments, not blinded inter-rater or clinical validation.

summary.interpretation: Counts cover the same 17 selected difficult stage cases per model. They judge summary/criterion evidence, not exact-ID agreement, overall accuracy, process safety or clinical efficacy.

coverage.selection: All 13 originally ambiguous/insufficient anchors, plus distinct dance S6 and sport S1/S4/S5 equipment/posture/chronology checks. This is a deliberately difficult subset, not a general accuracy sample.
